From level %level% every level gives you a point for your Passive Skill Tree, a great web of bonuses beside your class skills.

Small nodes give stats, larger ones give strong bonuses, and rare keystones give great power with a price. Some nodes even teach a real skill, such as Spoil or Dwarven Craft.

See your tree with .passives or Passive Tree on the Community Board (Alt+B), and spend your points on its own page: type .treelink for your link. A point can be taken back node by node, so don't be afraid to try.
